description: This file defines the DurableValue generic class implementing the IDurableValue<T> interface, providing durable storage for a value with serialization, state management, and persistence logic within Orleans persistence framework.

classes.name: DurableValue<T>
classes.description: A sealed class that manages a durable, serializable value, supporting state recovery, persistence, and snapshot functionalities.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Property to get or set the contained value, marking the state as dirty when set.

methods.name: OnModified
methods.description: Marks the object as modified to indicate the state should be persisted.

methods.name: OnValuePersisted
methods.description: Invokes the OnPersisted callback, indicating successful persistence.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to update the current value based on serialized data.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Appends the current state to the log if dirty.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Writes a snapshot of the current value to the provided writer.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the durable value (not yet implemented).

methods.name: WriteState
methods.description: Serializes the current value and writes it using the provided writer.
